definitions.explanation: Not burning, or not able to catch fire. Used mainly in compounds, above all in waste sorting ({不燃|ふねん}ごみ) and building materials ({不燃|ふねん}{材|ざい}).

examples.japanese: ⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不燃|ふねん}ごみ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Batteries go out with the noncombustible garbage.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不燃|ふねん}{材|ざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Noncombustible materials are used in the walls of this building.

notes:
The opposite is ⟦{可燃|かねん}→可燃：26077_kanen⟧ (combustible). Most municipalities split household waste into ⟦{可燃|かねん}ごみ→可燃ごみ：09535_kanengomi⟧ (also ⟦{燃|も}える→燃える：02312_moeru⟧⟦ごみ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧) and {不燃|ふねん}ごみ (also ⟦{燃|も}えない→燃える：02312_moeru⟧⟦ごみ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧); collection days for each are posted at the neighborhood collection point.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不燃|ふねん}ごみ: noncombustible garbage (metal, glass, ceramics)
- {不燃|ふねん}{材|ざい}: noncombustible building material
- {不燃|ふねん}{性|せい}: nonflammability
- {不燃|ふねん}⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧: noncombustible items
